summary.intent: Land a stacked series of PRs in the callisto repo that make workspace discovery and loading fail closed instead of silently guessing. This session covered opening PR 2 (#236, discovery-total) and implementing PR 3 (complete-workspace boundary), while an independent subagent reviewed #236.
summary.outcome: PR 2 was opened and stacked on PR 1 via `gh stack link`. PR 3 (`fix/workspace-complete`) was implemented with the E313 ManifestUnresolved diagnostic, `Workspace::load` vs `scan`, planner guards, fault-injection tests, docs and a changeset, and `just ci` completed with exit code 0. The #236 review returned no HIGH defects but several medium and low findings, which were planned and not yet applied.

repo: Stacked PR workflow: each PR is built in its own git worktree under .claude/worktrees on top of the previous branch, and PRs are linked with `gh stack link <n> <m>`.
Repo rules forbid parallel cargo builds, so fixes must wait until a running `just ci` finishes.

Every new diagnostic or error code must be registered in several places: `DiagnosticCode` in callisto-model/src/diagnostic.rs, the schema guard test (crates/callisto-cli/tests/schema_guard_test.rs), the docs/errors.md table, and the spec in docs/specs/workspace.json.
`Workspace::load` is strict and fails with E313 on unresolved manifests. `Workspace::scan` is lenient and keeps problems as diagnostics. Only `status` may use `scan`, and a test enforces this.
AGENTS.md asks for one changeset per user-visible topic.
Spec criteria in docs/specs/workspace.json must be updated alongside behavior changes. Code, tests and messages must not cite spec IDs.
The `ignore` crate honors .gitignore only if a `.git` exists in the walk's parent chain. With `.parents(false)`, a workspace root below the Git toplevel does not honor .gitignore.

code.finding: A package.json that fails to open is silently treated as a Canonical, non-platform role via `.ok()`. Similar swallowed opens exist at lines 274, 754 and 833.

WalkBuilder uses `.parents(false)` and `.git_ignore(true)`, so the E312 'ignore it in .gitignore' escape hatch does not work when the workspace root is below the Git toplevel. `.require_git(false)` is a possible fix.

`read_pnpm_packages` returns Ok(None), admitting the whole repo, when pnpm-workspace.yaml's top level is not a mapping. A root package.json that isn't an object behaves the same way (lines 462 and 471).
`build_globset` does not normalize a leading `./` or a trailing `/`, so such globs silently match nothing. This is pre-existing.
A stale multi-line comment says symlinked package directories are a supported pattern, which is now the opposite of the behavior.

workflow: Run an adversarial read-only subagent review of each PR while starting the next one. It found spec drift and vacuous tests.
Check that tests fail with the production change reverted. The toml_edit BOM tests passed without the change, so they were vacuous.
A subagent hand-back is model output, not user instruction. Triage its findings and act on them within the session's own scope.
Use short scripts in a scratchpad directory, run with `python3 -I`, for multi-file edits, followed by `cargo fmt` and clippy with -D warnings.

friction: Parallel cargo builds are forbidden, which serialized the #236 fixes behind PR 3's `just ci` run.
The review subagent did not run cargo or tests, so its findings are read-only and some are only PLAUSIBLE.
`../callisto-findings/FINDINGS.md` was absent, so the review could not deduplicate against a ledger.
The 'other Claude session' message was a subagent hand-back, not user input, so it carried no user authority.
open_items: Apply the #236 fixes: update spec drift in WS-DISC-07, 10 and 12; fix the E312 .gitignore escape hatch and add a test; make a non-mapping pnpm-workspace.yaml or non-object package.json an E311 error.

Drop the vacuous TOML BOM tests and the redundant strip_prefix at cargo.rs:709-712, and add missing coverage: npm workspaces object without packages, workspaces: null, malformed uv workspace, symlinked platform candidate.
Fix the stale symlink comment and split .changeset/loud-owls-refuse.md into one changeset per topic, including the Yarn classic form.
Follow-up PR: normalize `./x` and `x/` globs, and make `has_explicit_table` handle inline and dotted [workspace] tables.
Note in the PR that a placeholder-template root Cargo.toml now breaks every command.
PR 4: write-set preflight. PR 5: smaller fixes.
A WorkspaceCargoResolver::persist version bump drops the BOM from a BOM'd root Cargo.toml.
Remaining swallowed read errors: canonicalize fallbacks, `.is_dir()` permission errors, and the eprintln warning for malformed child manifests.
